name: A Round Fan Borne by the Guard of the Imperial Concubines of the Third Rank
summary: Page of the illustrated manuscript "The Illustrated Regulations for Ceremonial Paraphernalia of the Present Dynasty." It shows an illustration of a Round Fan borne by the Guard of the Imperial concubines of the third rank with a caption.
